name: fynd-code-guide
description: Builds Fynd's local code guide from Markdown walkthroughs.

scripts.check: node build.mjs --check && node --check assets/guide.js && prettier --check build.mjs assets/guide.js styles.css template.html pages README.md package.json
scripts.format: prettier --write build.mjs assets/guide.js styles.css template.html pages README.md package.json
